In `ServiceNowIntegration.syncAttributes()`: Synchronizes ServiceNow attributes with the local system.

This method: 1. Ensures only one synchronization job runs at a time using the RUNNING flag 2. Retrieves credential information for authentication 3. Constructs the base URL for ServiceNow API calls 4. Initiates parallel synchronization of different attribute types: - Categories and subcategories - Services - Technicians - Impact levels - Urgency levels 5. Updates the integration configuration in the database when all synchronizations complete

The method uses a Future.join pattern to run all synchronization tasks in parallel and update the database only when all tasks have completed.

        var context = TestConstants.prepareParams(testInfo.getTestMethod().get().getName());

        Bootstrap.vertx().eventBus().<JsonObject>localConsumer("test.trimmed.stack.trace", message ->

            try
            {
                var event = message.body();

                assertEquals(event.getInteger("untrimmedLineCount"), event.getInteger("trimmedLineCount"));

                testContext.completeNow();
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                LOGGER.error(exception);

                testContext.failNow(exception.getMessage());
            }
        });

    protected void enrichGroups(JsonObject object)
    {
        var objectGroups = object.getJsonArray(AIOpsObject.OBJECT_GROUPS);

        if (CommonUtil.isNotNullOrEmpty(objectGroups))
        {
            var groups = new JsonArray();

            for (var i = 0; i < objectGroups.size(); i++)
            {
                var groupBuilder = new StringBuilder();

                CommonUtil.normalizeGroupHierarchy(GroupConfigStore.getStore().getItem(objectGroups.getLong(i)), groupBuilder, null);

                groups.add(groupBuilder.toString());
            }

            object.put(AIOpsObject.OBJECT_GROUPS, StringUtils.join(groups, COMMA_SEPARATOR));
        }
    }

Manages the caching of flow data to improve performance and handle high volumes of flow information.

The FlowCacheProcessor is responsible for efficiently managing flow data in memory and on disk. It implements mechanisms for storing, retrieving, and processing flow data to handle high volumes of network traffic information without overwhelming system resources.

Key responsibilities of this class include:

  • Initializing and managing flow cache files on disk
  • Buffering flow data in memory before writing to disk
  • Processing cached flow data in batches
  • Monitoring flow rates and ensuring they stay within license limits
  • Implementing efficient data structures for flow data storage
  • Managing the lifecycle of flow cache files

The FlowCacheProcessor works closely with other components in the flow package:

  • It receives flow data from the FlowProcessor
  • It provides cached data to the FlowStatCalculator for statistical analysis
  • It interacts with the license system to ensure flow processing stays within licensed limits

This class is deployed as a Vert.x verticle and integrates with the event bus system for communication with other components.

The LicenseJob class is responsible for managing license-related operations in the Motadata platform.

This class implements the Quartz Job interface and performs daily license management tasks:

  1. Resetting license quotas (log and flow quotas)
  2. Checking license expiry and sending notifications
  3. Taking action when the license expires (undeploying licensed verticles)

The job sends notifications at specific intervals before license expiry (30, 15, 7, 3, 1, and 0 days) to remind administrators to renew their license. When the license expires, it also takes action to suspend monitoring functionality.

The job is scheduled to run daily at midnight (12:00 AM) to ensure timely notifications and proper license management.

+                        var targets = context.getJsonArray("topology.filter.targets");
+
+                        switch (NMSConstants.TopologyFilterType.valueOfName(context.getString("topology.filter.target.type").split(DASH_SEPARATOR)[1]))
+                        {
+                            case IP_ADDRESS -> targets.forEach(target -> filters.add(CommonUtil.getString(target)));
+
+                            case IP_ADDRESS_RANGE ->
+                            {
+                                for (var index = 0; index < targets.size(); index++)
+                                {
+                                    var range = targets.getString(index);
+
+                                    var start = range.split("-")[0].trim();
+
+                                    var end = start.substring(0, start.lastIndexOf('.')) + "." + range.split("-")[1].trim();
+
+                                    if (APIUtil.validateRange(start, end))
+                                    {
+                                        CommonUtil.calculateIPRange(InetAddress.getByName(start), InetAddress.getByName(end)).forEach(ip -> filters.add(CommonUtil.getString(ip)));
+                                    }
+                                }
+                            }
+
+                            case GROUP -> ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getItemsByGroups(targets).forEach(id -> filters.add(ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getItem(CommonUtil.getLong(id)).getString(OBJECT_IP, EMPTY_VALUE)));
+
+                            case TAG -> ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getObjectIdsByTags(targets).forEach(id -> filters.add(ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getItemByObjectId(CommonUtil.getInteger(id)).getString(OBJECT_IP, EMPTY_VALUE)));
+
+                            default ->
+                            {
+                            }
+                        }
+
+                        event.put("topology.filter.target.type", targetType);
+                    }
+                }
+                catch (Exception exception)
+                {
+                    LOGGER.error(exception);

    /**
     * Merges SLO events into time intervals for global SLO calculation.
     *
     * @param events map of timestamp to event count changes
     * @param endTime the end time for merging
     * @return array of merged SLO flap events with durations
     */
    public static JsonArray merge(TreeMap<Long, Integer> events, long endTime)
    {
        var result = new JsonArray();

        try
        {
            if (!events.isEmpty())
            {
                var active = 0;

                var lastTimestamp = events.firstKey();

                for (var event : events.entrySet())
                {
                    var timestamp = event.getKey();

                    if (timestamp > lastTimestamp)
                    {
                        append(result, lastTimestamp, active > 0 ? SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED.ordinal() : SLOFlapStatus.HEALTHY.ordinal(), timestamp - lastTimestamp);
                    }

                    active += event.getValue();

                    lastTimestamp = timestamp;
                }

                // Add final interval from last event to endTime
                if (endTime > lastTimestamp)
                {
                    append(result, lastTimestamp, active > 0 ? SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED.ordinal() : SLOFlapStatus.HEALTHY.ordinal(), endTime - lastTimestamp);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

        if (CommonUtil.traceEnabled())
        {
            LOGGER.trace(String.format("result after merging is %s", result));
        }

        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Appends or merges an SLO flap event to the result array.
     *
     * @param result the result array to append to
     * @param timestamp the event timestamp
     * @param sloStatus the SLO status (0=healthy, 1=degraded)
     * @param duration the duration of this status
     */
    private static void append(JsonArray result, long timestamp, int sloStatus, long duration)
    {
        var valid = false;

        if (!result.isEmpty())
        {
            var lastFlap = result.getJsonObject(result.size() - 1);

            if (lastFlap.getInteger(SLO_STATUS_FLAP) == sloStatus)
            {
                var newDuration = lastFlap.getLong(SLO_DURATION) + duration;

                lastFlap.put(SLO_DURATION, newDuration);

                valid = true;
            }
        }

        if (!valid)
        {
            result.add(new JsonObject()
                    .put(TIME_STAMP, timestamp)
                    .put(SLO_STATUS_FLAP, sloStatus)
                    .put(SLO_DURATION, duration));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------ SLO Utility Methods ------------------------ //

    public static void updateSLO(Set<String> mappers, StringBuilder builder, TreeMap<Long, Integer> events, JsonObject data, SLOFlapStatus currentStatus, long currentTimestamp, long objectId, String instance, long sloId, long cycleId, boolean manualFlap)
    {
        try
        {
            SLOFlapStatus lastSLOStatus;
            var lastTimeStamp = data.getLong(LAST_TIMESTAMP);
            var durationLeft = data.getLong(DURATION_LEFT);
            var downIncidentCount = data.getInteger(DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT, 0);

            // means first poll received
            if (data.getInteger(LAST_SLO_STATUS) == null)
            {
                lastSLOStatus = currentStatus;
                lastTimeStamp = currentTimestamp;

                // if the current status is breached then update the breached timestamp`
                if (currentStatus == SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED)
                {
                    // sloEvents are only for slo instances not for global slo
                    if (objectId != NOT_AVAILABLE)
                    {
                        events.merge(currentTimestamp, +1, Integer::sum);
                    }

                    downIncidentCount++;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                lastSLOStatus = SLOFlapStatus.values()[data.getInteger(LAST_SLO_STATUS)];

                // if current status and last status is not matched then it's a flap
                if (lastSLOStatus != currentStatus || manualFlap)
                {
                    // ONE OF THE MAIN CASE WHERE MANUAL FLAP IS UPDATED THE LAST TIMESTAMP AND THEN POLL EVENT RECEIVED WITH LITTLE BIT OLDER TIMESTAMP THEN LAST TIMESTAMP
                    // IN THIS CASE WE CAN ONLY ADJUST THE LAST TIMESTAMP TO CURRENT TIMESTAMP
                    if (currentTimestamp < lastTimeStamp)
                    {
                        if (CommonUtil.debugEnabled())
                        {
                            LOGGER.debug(String.format("current timestamp %s is less than last timestamp %s hence updating current timestamp to last timestamp", currentTimestamp, lastTimeStamp));
                        }

                        currentTimestamp = lastTimeStamp;
                    }

                    var duration = currentTimestamp - lastTimeStamp;

                    // this case happens when we dump manual flap and at the same time actual flap occurs
                    if (duration > 0)
                    {
                        if (lastSLOStatus == SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED)
                        {
                            durationLeft -= duration;
                        }

                        // flap for slo instances
                        if (objectId != NOT_AVAILABLE)
                        {
                            write(mappers, builder, ArchivedObjectConfigStore.getStore().getObjectIdById(objectId),
                                    instance,
                                    DatastoreConstants.DatastoreType.SLO_FLAP_METRIC,
                                    DatastoreConstants.PluginId.SLO_INSTANCE_FLAP,
                                    sloId + GROUP_SEPARATOR + cycleId,
                                    VisualizationConstants.VisualizationDataSource.SLO_INSTANCE_FLAP.getName(),
                                    lastTimeStamp,
                                    buildSLOFlapEvent(lastSLOStatus.ordinal(), duration, instance));
                        }
                        // flap for global slo
                        else
                        {
                            write(mappers, builder, sloId,
                                    cycleId + EMPTY_VALUE,
                                    DatastoreConstants.DatastoreType.SLO_FLAP_METRIC,
                                    DatastoreConstants.PluginId.SLO_FLAP,
                                    EMPTY_VALUE,
                                    VisualizationConstants.VisualizationDataSource.SLO_FLAP.getName(),
                                    lastTimeStamp,
                                    buildGlobalSLOFlapEvent(lastSLOStatus.ordinal(), duration, cycleId + EMPTY_VALUE));
                        }
                    }
                    else if (duration < 0)
                    {
                        LOGGER.warn(String.format("duration is %s", duration));
                    }
                    else if (CommonUtil.debugEnabled())
                    {
                        LOGGER.debug("duration is 0 due to flap timestamp received at same time of manual flap");
                    }

                    // don't update these details when manually dumping flap into the DB.
                    if (!manualFlap)
                    {
                        // update the respective incident count
                        if (currentStatus == SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED)
                        {
                            downIncidentCount++;
                        }

                        // sloEvents are only for slo instances not for global slo
                        if (objectId != NOT_AVAILABLE)
                        {
                            if (currentStatus == SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED)
                            {
                                events.merge(currentTimestamp, +1, Integer::sum);
                            }
                            else if (lastSLOStatus == SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED)
                            {
                                events.merge(currentTimestamp, -1, Integer::sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    lastSLOStatus = currentStatus;
                    lastTimeStamp = currentTimestamp;
                }
            }

            data.put(LAST_SLO_STATUS, lastSLOStatus.ordinal())
                    .put(LAST_TIMESTAMP, lastTimeStamp)
                    .put(DURATION_LEFT, durationLeft)
                    .put(DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT, downIncidentCount);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return achieved percentage i.e. duration left * 100 / total duration
     */
    private static float getSLOAchievedPercentage(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return CommonUtil.getFloat((data.getLong(SLOConstants.DURATION_LEFT) * 100) / (float) cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_TOTAL_DURATION));
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return violated seconds i.e. total duration - duration left
     */
    private static long getSLOViolatedSeconds(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_TOTAL_DURATION) - data.getLong(DURATION_LEFT);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return meantime to resolve i.e. violated seconds / down incident count
     */
    private static long getSLOMeanTimeToResolve(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            if (data.containsKey(DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT) && data.getInteger(DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT) > 0)
            {
                return getSLOViolatedSeconds(data, cycle) / data.getInteger(DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT);
            }
            else
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param duration : total duration of the slo cycle
     * @return meantime between failure i.e. (total duration - violated seconds) / up incident count
     */
    private static long getSLOMeanTimeBetweenFailure(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle, long duration)
    {
        try
        {
            if (data.containsKey(DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT) && data.getInteger(DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT) > 0)
            {
                return (duration - getSLOViolatedSeconds(data, cycle)) / data.getInteger(DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT);
            }
            else
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return violated percentage i.e. 100 - {@link #getSLOAchievedPercentage(JsonObject, JsonObject)}
     */
    private static float getSLOViolatedPercentage(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return 100 - getSLOAchievedPercentage(data, cycle);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param target : target of slo profile
     * @param warning : warning of slo profile
     * @return status of slo based on achieved percentage
     */
    private static int getSLOStatus(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle, float target, float warning)
    {
        try
        {
            var achieved = getSLOAchievedPercentage(data, cycle);

            if (achieved < target)
            {
                return SLOStatus.BREACHED.ordinal();
            }
            else if (achieved < warning)
            {
                return SLOStatus.WARNING.ordinal();
            }
            else
            {
                return SLOStatus.OK.ordinal();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return SLOStatus.OK.ordinal();
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return last slo status
     */
    public static SLOFlapStatus getLastSLOStatus(JsonObject data)
    {
        try
        {
            return SLOFlapStatus.values()[data.getInteger(LAST_SLO_STATUS, 0)];
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return SLOFlapStatus.HEALTHY;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param cycle : slo cycle details
     * @return error budget left percentage
     */
    private static float getSLOErrorBudgetLeftPercentage(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return CommonUtil.getFloat(100 - (((cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_TOTAL_DURATION) - data.getLong(SLOConstants.DURATION_LEFT)) * 100) / (float) cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_ACCEPTABLE_VIOLATION_TIME)));
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param cycle : slo cycle details
     * @return error budget left seconds
     */
    private static long getSLOErrorBudgetLeftSeconds(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_ACCEPTABLE_VIOLATION_TIME) - (cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_TOTAL_DURATION) - data.getLong(DURATION_LEFT));
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0L;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Calculates elapsed time burn rate
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param cycle : slo cycle details
     * @param targetPercentage : SLO target (e.g., 90 for 90%)
     * @param duration : elapsed time since cycle start
     * @return burn rate as multiplier (e.g., 1.5 means 1.5x burn rate)
     */
    private static float getSLOBurnRate(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle, float targetPercentage, long duration)
    {
        try
        {
            // Avoid division by zero
            if (duration <= 0)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Calculate total violated seconds
            var totalViolatedSeconds = getSLOViolatedSeconds(data, cycle);

            // Calculate current error rate based on elapsed time
            var currentErrorRate = totalViolatedSeconds / (float) duration;

            // Calculate acceptable error rate
            var acceptableErrorRate = (100 - targetPercentage) / 100.0f;

            // Avoid division by zero
            if (acceptableErrorRate <= 0)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Calculate burn rate
            return CommonUtil.getFloat(currentErrorRate / acceptableErrorRate);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Writes SLO event data to the datastore.
     *
     * @param objectId the object ID
     * @param instance the instance name
     * @param datastoreType the datastore type
     * @param pluginId the plugin ID
     * @param pluginIdSuffix the plugin ID suffix
     * @param name the metric name
     * @param timestamp the event timestamp
     * @param event the event data to write
     */
    public static void write(Set<String> mappers, StringBuilder builder, long objectId, String instance, DatastoreConstants.DatastoreType datastoreType, DatastoreConstants.PluginId pluginId, String pluginIdSuffix, String name, long timestamp, JsonObject event)
    {
        try
        {
            if (CommonUtil.traceEnabled())
            {
                LOGGER.trace(String.format("writing at %s slo event to datastore for object id %s and instance %s with plugin id suffix %s with datastore type %s and event %s", timestamp, objectId, instance, pluginIdSuffix, datastoreType.name(), event.encode()));
            }

            var buffer = Buffer.buffer("UTF-8");

            appendBytes(buffer, pluginId, datastoreType, pluginIdSuffix, name, timestamp);

            buffer.appendIntLE(CommonUtil.getInteger(objectId));

            buffer.appendIntLE(instance.length());

            buffer.appendString(instance);

            for (var entry : event.getMap().entrySet())
            {
                if (entry.getValue() != null)
                {
                    var column = entry.getKey();

                    var value = CommonUtil.getString(entry.getValue());

                    var category = DatastoreConstants.getDataCategory(false, column, value);

                    buffer.appendByte(category);

                    var bytes = column.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

                    buffer.appendIntLE(bytes.length);

                    buffer.appendBytes(bytes);

                    if (category == DatastoreConstants.DataCategory.FLOAT.getName())
                    {
                        ByteUtil.writeDouble(buffer, CommonUtil.getDouble(value));
                    }
                    else if (category == DatastoreConstants.DataCategory.NUMERIC.getName())//if it has decimal number than convert it into integer
                    {
                        buffer.appendLongLE(Math.round(CommonUtil.getDouble(value)));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        bytes = value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

                        buffer.appendIntLE(bytes.length);

                        buffer.appendBytes(bytes);
                    }

                    // update metric columns
                    builder.setLength(0);

                    builder.append(category).append(COLUMN_SEPARATOR).append(pluginId.getName()).append(COLUMN_SEPARATOR).append(column).append(COLUMN_SEPARATOR).append(NO);

                    if (!mappers.contains(builder.toString()))
                    {
                        mappers.add(builder.toString());

                        Bootstrap.vertx().eventBus().publish(EventBusConstants.EVENT_COLUMN_MAPPER_UPDATE,
                                new JsonObject()
                                        .put(CHANGE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE, EventBusConstants.ChangeNotificationType.UPDATE_METRIC_COLUMN.name())
                                        .put(DatastoreConstants.MAPPER, builder.toString()));
                    }
                }
            }

            Bootstrap.vertx().eventBus().send(EventBusConstants.EVENT_DATASTORE_WRITE + "." + DatastoreConstants.DatastoreCategory.METRIC.getName(), buffer.getBytes());
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Appends header bytes to the datastore buffer.
     *
     * @param buffer the buffer to append to
     * @param pluginId the plugin ID
     * @param datastoreType the datastore type
     * @param pluginIdSuffix the plugin ID suffix
     * @param name the metric name
     * @param timestamp the timestamp
     */
    private static void appendBytes(Buffer buffer, DatastoreConstants.PluginId pluginId, DatastoreConstants.DatastoreType datastoreType, String pluginIdSuffix, String name, long timestamp)
    {
        buffer.setLongLE(0, timestamp);

        var plugin = pluginId.getName() + DASH_SEPARATOR + name + (pluginIdSuffix.isEmpty() ? EMPTY_VALUE : DOT_SEPARATOR + pluginIdSuffix);

        var bytes = plugin.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        buffer.appendIntLE(bytes.length);

        buffer.appendBytes(bytes);

        buffer.appendByte(DatastoreConstants.DatastoreFormat.VERTICAL.getName().byteValue());

        buffer.appendByte(CommonUtil.getByteValue(datastoreType.ordinal()));
    }

    /**
     * Builds a global SLO flap event for datastore storage.
     *
     * @param lastSLOStatus the last SLO status
     * @param duration the flap duration
     * @param instance the instance name
     * @return the formatted SLO flap event
     */
    private static JsonObject buildGlobalSLOFlapEvent(int lastSLOStatus, long duration, String instance)
    {
        var event = new JsonObject();

        try
        {
            event.put(SLO_STATUS_FLAP, lastSLOStatus)
                    .put(SLO_DURATION, duration)
                    .put(SLO_NAME, instance);

        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

        return event;
    }

    /**
     * Builds an SLO flap event for instance-level monitoring.
     *
     * @param lastSLOStatus the last SLO status
     * @param duration the flap duration
     * @param instance the instance name
     * @return the formatted SLO flap event
     */
    private static JsonObject buildSLOFlapEvent(int lastSLOStatus, long duration, String instance)
    {
        var event = new JsonObject();

        try
        {
            var isInstance = !instance.isEmpty();

            event.put(isInstance ? SLO_INSTANCE_STATUS_FLAP : SLO_OBJECT_STATUS_FLAP, lastSLOStatus)
                    .put(isInstance ? SLO_INSTANCE_DURATION : SLO_OBJECT_DURATION, duration);

            if (isInstance)
            {
                event.put(SLO_INSTANCE_NAME, instance);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

        return event;
    }

    /**
     * Builds a global SLO calculation event with all metrics.
     *
     * @param data the SLO data
     * @param sloCycle the SLO cycle configuration
     * @param target the SLO target percentage
     * @param warning the SLO warning percentage
     * @param instance the instance name
     * @param duration the elapsed duration
     * @param availability true if this is an availability SLO
     * @return the formatted SLO calculation event
     */
    public static JsonObject buildGlobalSLOCalculationEvent(JsonObject data, JsonObject sloCycle, float target, float warning, String instance, long duration, boolean availability)
    {
        var event = new JsonObject();

        try
        {
            event.put(SLO_ACHIEVED_PERCENT, getSLOAchievedPercentage(data, sloCycle))
                    .put(SLO_VIOLATED_PERCENT, getSLOViolatedPercentage(data, sloCycle))
                    .put(SLO_VIOLATED_SECONDS, getSLOViolatedSeconds(data, sloCycle))
                    .put(SLO_ERROR_BUDGET_LEFT_PERCENT, getSLOErrorBudgetLeftPercentage(data, sloCycle))
                    .put(SLO_ERROR_BUDGET_LEFT_SECONDS, getSLOErrorBudgetLeftSeconds(data, sloCycle))
                    .put(SLO_BURN_RATE, getSLOBurnRate(data, sloCycle, target, duration))
                    .put(SLO_STATUS, getSLOStatus(data, sloCycle, target, warning))
                    .put(SLO_NAME, instance);

            if (availability)
            {
                event.put(SLO_MTTR_SECONDS, getSLOMeanTimeToResolve(data, sloCycle))
                        .put(SLO_MTBF_SECONDS, getSLOMeanTimeBetweenFailure(data, sloCycle ,duration));
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

        return event;
    }

    private void recalculate(long correctedCycleId, Map<String, TreeMap<Long, Integer>> sloStatuses)
    {
        try
        {
            var correctedSLOCycle = SLOCycleConfigStore.getStore().getItem(correctedCycleId);

            var endTime = correctedSLOCycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_END_TIME);

            var startTime = correctedSLOCycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_START_TIME);

            var sloId = correctedSLOCycle.getLong(SLOProfile.SLO_PROFILE_ID);

            // send notification to db
            VisualizationConstants.sendCycleStartNotification(sloId.toString(), correctedCycleId, startTime, LOGGER);

            var sloProfile = SLOProfileConfigStore.getStore().getItem(sloId);

            var sloContext = sloProfile.getJsonObject(SLOProfile.SLO_PROFILE_CONTEXT);

            var availability = sloProfile.getString(SLOProfile.SLO_PROFILE_TYPE, EMPTY_VALUE).equalsIgnoreCase(SLOType.AVAILABILITY.getName());

            var duration = correctedSLOCycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_END_TIME) - correctedSLOCycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_START_TIME);

            var sloEvents = new TreeMap<Long, Integer>();

            sloEvents.put(startTime, 0);

            for (var entry : sloStatuses.entrySet())
            {
                var data = new JsonObject().put(DURATION_LEFT, duration);

                var key = entry.getKey();

                var tokens = key.split(INSTANCE_SEPARATOR);

                var objectId = CommonUtil.getLong(tokens[0]);

                var instance = tokens.length > 1 ? tokens[1] : EMPTY_VALUE;

                for (var event : entry.getValue().entrySet())
                {
                    updateSLO(mappers, builder, sloEvents, data, SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.values()[event.getValue()], event.getKey(), objectId, instance, sloId, correctedCycleId, false);
                }

                // update the last flap
                updateSLO(mappers, builder, sloEvents, data, getLastSLOStatus(data), endTime, objectId, instance, sloId, correctedCycleId, true);

                write(mappers, builder, ArchivedObjectConfigStore.getStore().getObjectIdById(objectId),
                        instance,
                        DatastoreConstants.DatastoreType.SLO_METRIC,
                        DatastoreConstants.PluginId.SLO_INSTANCE,
                        sloId + GROUP_SEPARATOR + correctedCycleId,
                        VisualizationConstants.VisualizationDataSource.SLO_INSTANCE.getName(),
                        endTime,
                        buildSLOCalculationEvent(data, correctedSLOCycle, sloContext.getFloat(SLOProfile.SLO_TARGET), sloContext.getFloat(SLOProfile.SLO_WARNING), instance, duration, availability));
            }

            // global SLO data
            var data = new JsonObject().put(DURATION_LEFT, duration);

            var result = merge(sloEvents, correctedSLOCycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_END_TIME));

            if (!result.isEmpty())
            {
                for (var index = 0; index < result.size(); index++)
                {
                    var event = result.getJsonObject(index);

                    updateSLO(mappers, builder, sloEvents, data, SLOFlapStatus.values()[event.getInteger(SLO_STATUS_FLAP)], event.getLong(TIME_STAMP), NOT_AVAILABLE, EMPTY_VALUE, sloId, correctedCycleId, true);
                }
            }

            // update the last flap
            updateSLO(mappers, builder, sloEvents, data, getLastSLOStatus(data), endTime, NOT_AVAILABLE, EMPTY_VALUE, sloId, correctedCycleId, true);

            write(mappers, builder, sloId,
                    correctedCycleId + EMPTY_VALUE,
                    DatastoreConstants.DatastoreType.SLO_METRIC,
                    DatastoreConstants.PluginId.SLO,
                    EMPTY_VALUE,
                    VisualizationConstants.VisualizationDataSource.SLO.getName(),
                    endTime,
                    buildGlobalSLOCalculationEvent(data, correctedSLOCycle, sloContext.getFloat(SLOProfile.SLO_TARGET), sloContext.getFloat(SLOProfile.SLO_WARNING), correctedCycleId + EMPTY_VALUE, duration, availability));
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }
    }

    {

            {
                events.put(end, right.getValue());
            }

            events.put(start, SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.CORRECTED.ordinal());

            events.put(end, SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.CORRECTED.ordinal());

            for (var entry : events.subMap(start, false, end, true).entrySet())
            {
                entry.setValue(SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.CORRECTED.ordinal());
            }

    public static void applyCorrection(TreeMap<Long, Integer> events, List<long[]> correctionTimestamps)
    {
        for (var timestamp : correctionTimestamps)
        {
            var start = timestamp[0];
            var end = timestamp[1];

            // ---- Find baseline status before correction starts ----
            var left = events.floorEntry(start);
            int baselineStatus = (left != null) ? left.getValue() : 0; // default UP if nothing before

            // ---- Ensure we have entry at start ----
            events.put(start, baselineStatus);

            // ---- Ensure we have entry at end ----
            var right = events.floorEntry(end);
            var restoreStatus = (right != null && right.getValue() != SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.CORRECTED.ordinal())
                    ? right.getValue()
                    : baselineStatus; // fallback to baseline if correction inside corrected range

            events.put(end, restoreStatus);

            // ---- Apply correction inside [start, end) ----
            for (var entry : events.subMap(start, true, end, false).entrySet())
            {
                entry.setValue(SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.CORRECTED.ordinal());
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Merges SLO events into time intervals for global SLO calculation.
     *
     * @param events map of timestamp to event count changes
     * @param endTime the end time for merging
     * @return array of merged SLO flap events with durations
     */
    private JsonArray merge(TreeMap<Long, Integer> events, long endTime)
    {
        var result = new JsonArray();

        try
        {
            if (!events.isEmpty())
            {
                var active = 0;

                var lastTimestamp = events.firstKey();

                for (var event : events.entrySet())
                {
                    var timestamp = event.getKey();

                    if (timestamp > lastTimestamp)
                    {
                        append(result, lastTimestamp, active > 0 ? SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED.ordinal() : SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.HEALTHY.ordinal(), timestamp - lastTimestamp);
                    }

                    active += event.getValue();

                    lastTimestamp = timestamp;
                }

                // Add final interval from last event to endTime
                if (endTime > lastTimestamp)
                {
                    append(result, lastTimestamp, active > 0 ? SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.DEGRADED.ordinal() : SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.HEALTHY.ordinal(), endTime - lastTimestamp);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

        if (CommonUtil.traceEnabled())
        {
            LOGGER.trace(String.format("result after merging is %s", result));
        }

        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Appends or merges an SLO flap event to the result array.
     *
     * @param result the result array to append to
     * @param timestamp the event timestamp
     * @param sloStatus the SLO status (0=healthy, 1=degraded)
     * @param duration the duration of this status
     */
    private void append(JsonArray result, long timestamp, int sloStatus, long duration)
    {
        var valid = false;

        if (!result.isEmpty())
        {
            var lastFlap = result.getJsonObject(result.size() - 1);

            if (lastFlap.getInteger(SLOConstants.SLO_STATUS_FLAP) == sloStatus)
            {
                var newDuration = lastFlap.getLong(SLOConstants.SLO_DURATION) + duration;

                lastFlap.put(SLOConstants.SLO_DURATION, newDuration);

                valid = true;
            }
        }

        if (!valid)
        {
            result.add(new JsonObject()
                    .put(TIME_STAMP, timestamp)
                    .put(SLOConstants.SLO_STATUS_FLAP, sloStatus)
                    .put(SLOConstants.SLO_DURATION, duration));
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return achieved percentage i.e. duration left * 100 / total duration
     */
    private float getSLOAchievedPercentage(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return (data.getLong(SLOConstants.DURATION_LEFT) * 100) / (float) cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_TOTAL_DURATION);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return violated seconds i.e. total duration - duration left
     */
    private long getSLOViolatedSeconds(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_TOTAL_DURATION) - data.getLong(SLOConstants.DURATION_LEFT);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return meantime to resolve i.e. violated seconds / down incident count
     */
    private long getSLOMeanTimeToResolve(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            if (data.containsKey(SLOConstants.DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT) && data.getInteger(SLOConstants.DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT) > 0)
            {
                return getSLOViolatedSeconds(data, cycle) / data.getInteger(SLOConstants.DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT);
            }
            else
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param duration : total duration of the slo cycle
     * @return meantime between failure i.e. (total duration - violated seconds) / up incident count
     */
    private long getSLOMeanTimeBetweenFailure(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle, long duration)
    {
        try
        {
            if (data.containsKey(SLOConstants.DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT) && data.getInteger(SLOConstants.DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT) > 0)
            {
                return (duration - getSLOViolatedSeconds(data, cycle)) / data.getInteger(SLOConstants.DOWN_INCIDENT_COUNT);
            }
            else
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @return violated percentage i.e. 100 - {@link #getSLOAchievedPercentage(JsonObject, JsonObject)}
     */
    private float getSLOViolatedPercentage(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return 100 - getSLOAchievedPercentage(data, cycle);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param target : target of slo profile
     * @param warning : warning of slo profile
     * @return status of slo based on achieved percentage
     */
    private int getSLOStatus(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle, float target, float warning)
    {
        try
        {
            var achieved = getSLOAchievedPercentage(data, cycle);

            if (achieved < target)
            {
                return SLOConstants.SLOStatus.BREACHED.ordinal();
            }
            else if (achieved < warning)
            {
                return SLOConstants.SLOStatus.WARNING.ordinal();
            }
            else
            {
                return SLOConstants.SLOStatus.OK.ordinal();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return SLOConstants.SLOStatus.OK.ordinal();
        }
    }

    private SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus getLastSLOStatus(JsonObject data)

        {
            return SLOConstants.SLOFlapStatus.values()[data.getInteger(SLOConstants.LAST_SLO_STATUS, 0)];
        }
        catch (Exception exception)

    /**
     *
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param cycle : slo cycle details
     * @return error budget left percentage
     */
    private float getSLOErrorBudgetLeftPercentage(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return 100 - (((cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_TOTAL_DURATION) - data.getLong(SLOConstants.DURATION_LEFT)) * 100) / (float) cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_ACCEPTABLE_VIOLATION_TIME));

    /**

     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance
     * @param cycle : slo cycle details
     * @return error budget left seconds
     */
    private long getSLOErrorBudgetLeftSeconds(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle)
    {
        try
        {
            return cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_ACCEPTABLE_VIOLATION_TIME) - (cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_TOTAL_DURATION) - data.getLong(SLOConstants.DURATION_LEFT));
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0L;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Calculates elapsed time burn rate
     * @param data : metadata of particular slo profile and particular monitor or instance  
     * @param cycle : slo cycle details
     * @param targetPercentage : SLO target (e.g., 90 for 90%)
     * @param duration : elapsed time since cycle start
     * @return burn rate as multiplier (e.g., 1.5 means 1.5x burn rate)
     */
    private float getSLOBurnRate(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle, float targetPercentage, long duration)
    {
        try
        {
            // Avoid division by zero
            if (duration <= 0)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Calculate total violated seconds
            var totalViolatedSeconds = getSLOViolatedSeconds(data, cycle);

            // Calculate current error rate based on elapsed time
            var currentErrorRate = totalViolatedSeconds / (float) duration;

            // Calculate acceptable error rate  
            var acceptableErrorRate = (100 - targetPercentage) / 100.0f;

            // Avoid division by zero
            if (acceptableErrorRate <= 0)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Calculate burn rate
            return currentErrorRate / acceptableErrorRate;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Writes SLO event data to the datastore.
     *
     * @param objectId the object ID
     * @param instance the instance name
     * @param datastoreType the datastore type
     * @param pluginId the plugin ID
     * @param pluginIdSuffix the plugin ID suffix
     * @param name the metric name
     * @param timestamp the event timestamp
     * @param event the event data to write
     */
    private void write(long objectId, String instance, DatastoreConstants.DatastoreType datastoreType, DatastoreConstants.PluginId pluginId, String pluginIdSuffix, String name, long timestamp, JsonObject event)
    {
        try
        {
            if (CommonUtil.traceEnabled())
            {
                LOGGER.trace(String.format("event type %s : writing at %s slo event to datastore for object id %s and instance %s with plugin id suffix %s with datastore type %s and event %s", eventType, timestamp, objectId, instance, pluginIdSuffix, datastoreType.name(), event.encode()));
            }

            var buffer = Buffer.buffer("UTF-8");

            appendBytes(buffer, pluginId, datastoreType, pluginIdSuffix, name, timestamp);

            buffer.appendIntLE(CommonUtil.getInteger(objectId));

            buffer.appendIntLE(instance.length());

            buffer.appendString(instance);

            for (var entry : event.getMap().entrySet())
            {
                if (entry.getValue() != null)
                {
                    var column = entry.getKey();

                    var value = CommonUtil.getString(entry.getValue());

                    var category = DatastoreConstants.getDataCategory(false, column, value);

                    buffer.appendByte(category);

                    var bytes = column.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

                    buffer.appendIntLE(bytes.length);

                    buffer.appendBytes(bytes);

                    if (category == DatastoreConstants.DataCategory.FLOAT.getName())
                    {
                        ByteUtil.writeDouble(buffer, CommonUtil.getDouble(value));
                    }
                    else if (category == DatastoreConstants.DataCategory.NUMERIC.getName())//if it has decimal number than convert it into integer
                    {
                        buffer.appendLongLE(Math.round(CommonUtil.getDouble(value)));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        bytes = value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

                        buffer.appendIntLE(bytes.length);

                        buffer.appendBytes(bytes);
                    }

                    // update metric columns
                    builder.setLength(0);

                    builder.append(category).append(COLUMN_SEPARATOR).append(pluginId.getName()).append(COLUMN_SEPARATOR).append(column).append(COLUMN_SEPARATOR).append(NO);

                    if (!mappers.contains(builder.toString()))
                    {
                        mappers.add(builder.toString());

                        vertx.eventBus().publish(EventBusConstants.EVENT_COLUMN_MAPPER_UPDATE,
                                new JsonObject()
                                        .put(CHANGE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE, EventBusConstants.ChangeNotificationType.UPDATE_METRIC_COLUMN.name())
                                        .put(DatastoreConstants.MAPPER, builder.toString()));
                    }
                }
            }

            vertx.eventBus().send(EventBusConstants.EVENT_DATASTORE_WRITE + "." + DatastoreConstants.DatastoreCategory.METRIC.getName(), buffer.getBytes());
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Appends header bytes to the datastore buffer.
     *
     * @param buffer the buffer to append to
     * @param pluginId the plugin ID
     * @param datastoreType the datastore type
     * @param pluginIdSuffix the plugin ID suffix
     * @param name the metric name
     * @param timestamp the timestamp
     */
    private void appendBytes(Buffer buffer, DatastoreConstants.PluginId pluginId, DatastoreConstants.DatastoreType datastoreType, String pluginIdSuffix, String name, long timestamp)
    {
        buffer.setLongLE(0, timestamp);

        var plugin = pluginId.getName() + DASH_SEPARATOR + name + (pluginIdSuffix.isEmpty() ? EMPTY_VALUE : DOT_SEPARATOR + pluginIdSuffix);

        var bytes = plugin.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        buffer.appendIntLE(bytes.length);

        buffer.appendBytes(bytes);

        buffer.appendByte(DatastoreConstants.DatastoreFormat.VERTICAL.getName().byteValue());

        buffer.appendByte(CommonUtil.getByteValue(datastoreType.ordinal()));
    }

    /**
     * Builds a global SLO calculation event with all metrics.
     *
     * @param data the SLO data
     * @param sloCycle the SLO cycle configuration
     * @param target the SLO target percentage
     * @param warning the SLO warning percentage
     * @param instance the instance name
     * @param duration the elapsed duration
     * @param availability true if this is an availability SLO
     * @return the formatted SLO calculation event
     */
    private JsonObject buildGlobalSLOCalculationEvent(JsonObject data, JsonObject sloCycle, float target, float warning, String instance, long duration, boolean availability)

     * Builds an SLO calculation event for instance-level monitoring.
     *
     * @param data the SLO data
     * @param sloCycle the SLO cycle configuration
     * @param target the SLO target percentage
     * @param warning the SLO warning percentage
     * @param instance the instance name

     * @param availability true if this is an availability SLO
     * @return the formatted SLO calculation event
     */
    private JsonObject buildSLOCalculationEvent(JsonObject data, JsonObject sloCycle, float target, float warning, String instance, long duration, boolean availability)
    {
        var event = new JsonObject();

        try
        {
            var isInstance = !instance.isEmpty();

            event.put(isInstance ? SLOConstants.SLO_INSTANCE_ACHIEVED_PERCENT : SLOConstants.SLO_OBJECT_ACHIEVED_PERCENT, getSLOAchievedPercentage(data, sloCycle))
                    .put(isInstance ? SLOConstants.SLO_INSTANCE_VIOLATED_PERCENT : SLOConstants.SLO_OBJECT_VIOLATED_PERCENT, getSLOViolatedPercentage(data, sloCycle))
                    .put(isInstance ? SLOConstants.SLO_INSTANCE_VIOLATED_SECONDS : SLOConstants.SLO_OBJECT_VIOLATED_SECONDS, getSLOViolatedSeconds(data, sloCycle))

                    .put(isInstance ? SLOConstants.SLO_INSTANCE_STATUS : SLOConstants.SLO_OBJECT_STATUS, getSLOStatus(data, sloCycle, target, warning));

            if (availability)
            {
                event.put(isInstance ? SLOConstants.SLO_INSTANCE_MTTR_SECONDS : SLOConstants.SLO_OBJECT_MTTR_SECONDS, getSLOMeanTimeToResolve(data, sloCycle))

                event.put(SLOConstants.SLO_INSTANCE_NAME, instance);

        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

        return event;
    }

    protected void cloneTemplate(RoutingContext routingContext) {

        JsonObject jsonObject = routingContext.body().asJsonObject();

        Long templateId = jsonObject.getLong(ID);

        String templateName = jsonObject.getString(ENTITY_PROPERTY_NAME);

        try {
            LOGGER.info("Starting template cloning process for template ID: " + templateId);

            var template = TemplateConfigStore.getStore().getItem(templateId);

            if (template == null || template.isEmpty()) {

                LOGGER.warn("Template not found for cloning: " + templateId);

                this.send(routingContext, new JsonObject()
                        .put(RESPONSE_CODE, HttpStatus.SC_BAD_REQUEST)
                        .put(GlobalConstants.STATUS, GlobalConstants.STATUS_FAIL)
                        .put(ERROR_CODE, ErrorCodes.ERROR_CODE_BAD_REQUEST)
                        .put(MESSAGE, "Template not found with ID: " + templateId)
                );
                return;
            }

            template.remove(ID);

            template.put(TEMPLATE_NAME, templateName);

            LOGGER.info("Prepared cloned template structure with name: Copy of " + templateName);

            cloneTemplateWidgets(template)
                    .compose(v -> saveClonedTemplate(template))
                    .compose(parentTemplateId -> {
                        // Clone child templates
                        var childTemplates = TemplateConfigStore.getStore().getItemsByValue(TEMPLATE_PARENT_ID, templateId);

                        var cloneWidgetFutures = new ArrayList<Future<Void>>();

                        for (int i = 0; i < childTemplates.size(); i++) {

                            var childTemplate = childTemplates.getJsonObject(i);

                            childTemplate.put(TEMPLATE_PARENT_ID, parentTemplateId);

                            cloneWidgetFutures.add(cloneTemplateWidgets(childTemplate));
                        }

                        return Future.all(cloneWidgetFutures)
                                .compose(widgetCloneResult -> {

                                    var saveTemplateFutures = new ArrayList<Future<Long>>();

                                    for (int i = 0; i < childTemplates.size(); i++) {

                                        var childTemplate = childTemplates.getJsonObject(i);

                                        childTemplate.remove(ID);

                                        childTemplate.put(TEMPLATE_NAME, "Copy of " + childTemplate.getString(TEMPLATE_NAME));

                                        saveTemplateFutures.add(saveClonedTemplate(childTemplate));
                                    }

                                    return Future.all(saveTemplateFutures).compose(e-> Future.succeededFuture(parentTemplateId));

                                });
                    })
                    .onSuccess(parentTemplateId -> {

                        LOGGER.info("Template cloned successfully");

                        this.send(routingContext, new JsonObject()
                                .put(RESPONSE_CODE, HttpStatus.SC_OK)
                                .put(GlobalConstants.STATUS, GlobalConstants.STATUS_SUCCEED)
                                .put(MESSAGE, "Template cloned successfully")
                                .put(RESULT, parentTemplateId)
                        );
                    })
                    .onFailure(error -> {

                        LOGGER.error(error);

                        this.send(routingContext, new JsonObject()
                                .put(RESPONSE_CODE, HttpStatus.SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                                .put(GlobalConstants.STATUS, GlobalConstants.STATUS_FAIL)
                                .put(ERROR_CODE, ErrorCodes.ERROR_CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR)
                                .put(MESSAGE, "Failed to clone template: " + error)
                        );
                    });

        } catch (Exception exception) {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            this.send(routingContext, new JsonObject()
                    .put(RESPONSE_CODE, HttpStatus.SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                    .put(GlobalConstants.STATUS, GlobalConstants.STATUS_FAIL)
                    .put(ERROR_CODE, ErrorCodes.ERROR_CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR)
                    .put(MESSAGE, "Failed to clone template: " + exception.getMessage())
            );
        }
    }

    private Future<Void> cloneTemplateWidgets(JsonObject template)
    {
        Promise<Void> promise = Promise.promise();
        try
        {

            if (!template.containsKey("template.widgets"))
            {
                promise.complete(null);

                return Future.succeededFuture();
            }

            var templateWidgets = template.getJsonArray("template.widgets");

            if (templateWidgets.isEmpty())
            {
                LOGGER.debug("Empty widgets array for template");

                promise.complete();

                return Future.succeededFuture();
            }

            var futures = new ArrayList<Future<Void>>();

            LOGGER.info("Starting to clone " + templateWidgets.size() + " widgets");


            for (var i = 0; i < templateWidgets.size(); i++)
            {
                var item = templateWidgets.getJsonObject(i);

                if (item.containsKey(ID))
                {
                    // Retrieve the full widget from WidgetConfigStore
                    var widgetContext = WidgetConfigStore.getStore().getItem(item.getLong(ID));

                    widgetContext.put(VisualizationConstants.VISUALIZATION_NAME, String.format("Copy of %s", widgetContext.getString(VisualizationConstants.VISUALIZATION_NAME)));

                    widgetContext.remove(ID);

                    widgetContext.put("_type","1");

                    Promise<Void> widgetPromise = Promise.promise();

                    Bootstrap.configDBService().save(DBConstants.TBL_WIDGET, widgetContext, DEFAULT_USER, SYSTEM_REMOTE_ADDRESS, asyncResult ->
                    {
                        if (asyncResult.succeeded())
                        {
                            WidgetConfigStore.getStore().addItem(asyncResult.result()).onComplete(handler ->
                            {
                                if (handler.succeeded())
                                {
                                    item.put(ID, asyncResult.result());

                                    widgetPromise.complete();
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    LOGGER.trace(handler.cause().getMessage());

                                    widgetPromise.fail(handler.cause());
                                }
                            });
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            LOGGER.info(asyncResult.cause().getMessage());

                            widgetPromise.fail(asyncResult.cause());
                        }
                    });
                    futures.add(widgetPromise.future());
                }
            }


            Future.all(futures).onComplete(result ->
            {
                if (result.succeeded())
                {
                    LOGGER.info("All widget clones completed successfully, saving template");

                    promise.complete(null);

                }
                else
                {
                    LOGGER.warn("Some widget clones failed: " + result.cause().getMessage());

                    promise.fail("Failed to clone some widgets: " + result.cause().getMessage());
                }
            });

            return promise.future();
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);

            promise.fail(String.format(INTERNAL_SERVER_EXCEPTION, exception.getMessage()));

            return promise.future();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Helper method to save the cloned template to the database.
     *
     * @param template The template to save
     *
     */
    private Future<Long> saveClonedTemplate(JsonObject template)
    {

        template.put("_type","1");

        Promise<Long> promise = Promise.<Long>promise();

        Bootstrap.configDBService().save(DBConstants.TBL_TEMPLATE, template,
                GlobalConstants.DEFAULT_USER, GlobalConstants.SYSTEM_REMOTE_ADDRESS,
                result ->
                {
                    if (result.succeeded())
                    {
                        var newTemplateId = result.result();

                        LOGGER.info("Successfully saved cloned template with ID: " + newTemplateId);

                        // Add to TemplateConfigStore
                        TemplateConfigStore.getStore().addItem(newTemplateId).onComplete(asyncResult ->
                        {
                            if (asyncResult.succeeded())
                            {
                                promise.complete(newTemplateId);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                LOGGER.warn("Failed to add cloned template to store: " + asyncResult.cause().getMessage());

                                promise.fail(asyncResult.cause());
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        LOGGER.warn("Failed to save cloned template to database: " + result.cause().getMessage());

                        promise.fail(result.cause());
                    }
                });

        return promise.future();
    }

In `LogParser.flush()`: Flushes a parsed log event to storage and performs additional processing.

This method is responsible for the final processing and storage of parsed log events. It performs several important tasks:

  • Validates the event timestamp (drops events with timestamps before January 1, 2020)
  • Trims message length to prevent oversized log entries
  • Registers the source IP and category in the event source configuration store
  • Writes the parsed log to the database
  • Forwards the log to other components as needed (policy engine, statistics, forwarders)

The method behaves differently based on the bootstrap type:

  • For EVENT_COLLECTOR or EVENT_PROCESSOR: Sends the event to the remote event processor
  • For other types: Processes the event locally and writes it to storage
@param event The parsed log event to be flushed to storage

A Vert.x verticle responsible for polling metrics from monitored systems and devices.

The MetricPoller class is a central component of the monitoring system that:

1. Manages worker pools for different types of metric polling: - Regular metrics (SNMP, WMI, etc.) - Availability/ping checks - Network service (port) checks

2. Schedules and executes metric polling operations based on: - Metric category (Network, Server, Database, etc.) - Metric type (regular, availability, network service) - Timeout requirements - Batch processing capabilities

3. Implements load balancing and resource management: - Tracks idle workers across different categories - Distributes polling tasks based on worker availability - Handles metric queuing and prioritization - Implements auto-scaling of worker pools when needed

4. Processes polling results and sends them to appropriate event bus addresses

The class uses Vert.x's event-driven, non-blocking architecture to efficiently handle large numbers of concurrent polling operations with minimal resource usage.

In `ZMQServer.ZMQServer()`: ZeroMQ (ZMQ) server implementation for the Motadata transport layer.

This class provides a ZeroMQ-based transport server that supports multiple socket modes for different messaging patterns. It implements the {@link TransportServer} interface to provide a standardized transport abstraction layer for server-side operations.

The server supports different ZeroMQ socket patterns:

  • PUB (Sender): Publishes messages to multiple SUB receivers
  • PULL: Receives messages from multiple PUSH clients in a round-robin fashion
  • PUSH: Sends messages to PULL sockets in a load-balanced manner

Key features:

  • Configurable High Water Mark (HWM) for message queuing and flow control
  • TCP keep-alive support for connection reliability
  • Automatic handling of slow receivers (XPUB_NODROP)
  • Thread-safe message handling with atomic operations
  • Integration with Vert.x event bus for message routing
  • Support for both binding and connecting modes

Configuration example:

{@code   JsonObject config = new JsonObject()       .put("SOCKET_MODE", "PUB")       .put("HOST", "localhost")       .put("PORT", 5555)       .put("EVENT_TYPE", "remote.events");     ZMQServer server = new ZMQServer(config);   server.bind().onSuccess(v -> {       // Server is ready to accept connections       server.send("topic", "Hello World".getBytes());   });   }

Thread Safety: This class is thread-safe for concurrent access to its public methods. However, the underlying ZMQ socket operations are performed in dedicated threads.

This socket is configured based on the socket mode specified in the configuration. / private ZMQ.Socket server; / The event type identifier used for routing messages to the appropriate event bus consumers. Extracted from the configuration during initialization. / private final String eventType; / Atomic boolean flag indicating whether the server should continue processing events. Used to control the message receiving loop in a thread-safe manner. / private final AtomicBoolean hasMoreEvent = new AtomicBoolean(true); private Thread receiver; / Logger instance for this ZMQ server, configured with appropriate context and component name. / private static final Logger LOGGER = new Logger(ZMQServer.class, GlobalConstants.MOTADATA_EVENT_BUS, "ZMQ Server", GlobalConstants.BootstrapType.AGENT.equals(Bootstrap.bootstrapType())); / Constructs a new ZMQServer with the specified configuration.

The configuration object must contain the following required parameters:

  • SOCKET_MODE: The ZMQ socket mode (PUB, PULL, or PUSH)
  • HOST: The host address to bind to (for binding modes)
  • PORT: The port number to bind to or connect to
  • EVENT_TYPE: The event type for message routing

The constructor initializes the server configuration but does not establish the actual ZMQ socket connection. Call {@link #bind()} to start the server.

A decorator for TransportClient that provides automatic reconnection capabilities.

This class implements the TransportClient interface and wraps another TransportClient implementation, adding automatic reconnection functionality. It periodically checks the connection status and attempts to reconnect if the connection has been idle for longer than the configured timeout period.

Key features:

  • Transparent delegation to the underlying transport client
  • Periodic connection health checks
  • Automatic reconnection when connection is lost
  • Connection timeout based on message activity
  • Port availability verification before reconnection attempts

The reconnection logic works by:

  1. Tracking the timestamp of the last received message
  2. Periodically checking if the time since the last message exceeds the timeout
  3. Verifying that the remote endpoint is reachable
  4. Closing the existing connection and establishing a new one

Example usage:

{@code   // Create a base transport client   TransportClient baseClient = new ZMQClient(config);     // Wrap it with auto-reconnect functionality   TransportClient client = new AutoReconnectClient(baseClient, config);     // Use the client normally - reconnection is handled automatically   client.connect();   client.registerMessageHandler(message -> {       // Process message   });   client.receive();   }

Alternatively, use the TransportProvider factory method:

{@code   // Create a client with auto-reconnect enabled   JsonObject config = new JsonObject()       .put(TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL, TransportProtocol.ZMQ.getValue())       .put(AUTO_RECONNECT, true)       .put("host", "localhost")       .put("port", 5555);   TransportClient client = TransportProvider.getClient(config);   }

Composes and processes sub-query responses for visualization rendering.

This method is responsible for transforming raw metric data from database queries into visualization-ready format for different chart types (Histogram, Grid, etc.). It performs several key operations:

Core Functionality:

  • Data Transformation: Converts raw query results into visualization context
  • Aggregation Processing: Handles MIN, MAX, SUM, AVG aggregations for metrics
  • Entity Resolution: Resolves monitor IDs, groups, and tags for visualization grouping
  • Chart Context Creation: Builds appropriate visualization context based on category
  • Statistical Calculations: Computes grid statistics for histogram data

Supported Visualization Categories:

  • HISTOGRAM: Creates chart context with sorting and statistical aggregations
  • GRID: Creates grid context for tabular data display

Entity Grouping Support:

  • MONITOR: Groups by individual monitoring objects
  • GROUP: Groups by object groups
  • TAG: Groups by user-defined tags

Data Processing Flow:

  1. Extract visualization properties and sorting preferences
  2. Determine entity type (monitor/group/tag) from context
  3. Process raw data rows and calculate statistics if needed
  4. Resolve entity IDs and build entity collections
  5. Transform data points with aggregation support
  6. Build final visualization context and send to event bus

Error Handling:

The LDAPSyncJob class is responsible for synchronizing LDAP users with the Motadata platform.

This class implements the Quartz Job interface and is annotated with {@link DisallowConcurrentExecution} to ensure that only one instance of this job runs at a time. The job synchronizes user information from an LDAP server with the Motadata platform's user database.

The job is scheduled to run at configurable intervals, determined by the LDAP server configuration. The CRON expression used for scheduling is parameterized with placeholders (@@, ##) that are replaced with actual values when the job is scheduled.

The synchronization process ensures that user information in the Motadata platform remains consistent with the LDAP directory, which is often the authoritative source for user data in enterprise environments.

ZeroMQ (ZMQ) client implementation for the Motadata transport layer.

This class provides a ZeroMQ-based transport client that supports multiple socket modes including SUB (receiver), PUSH, and PULL patterns. It implements the {@link TransportClient} interface to provide a standardized transport abstraction layer.

The client supports different ZeroMQ socket patterns:

  • SUB (Receivers): Receives messages from PUB sockets, supports topic filtering
  • PUSH: Sends messages to PULL sockets in a load-balanced manner
  • PULL: Receives messages from PUSH sockets in a round-robin fashion

Key features:

  • Configurable High Water Mark (HWM) for message queuing
  • TCP keep-alive support for connection reliability
  • Topic-based message filtering for SUB sockets
  • Thread-safe message handling with atomic operations
  • Integration with Vert.x event bus for message routing
